subject: Intro + Exec demo: Proposed VP/CIO slot and recording guidance
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@heliohealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Anirban Roy <anirban.roy@heliohealth.com>, sourcing@heliohealth.com
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + Exec demo: HelioHealth discovery and VP/CIO attendance

Hi Priya & Priyom,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — our execs were impressed with the latency/cost numbers you shared. Procurement asked that we get a brief executive-level demo for our VP of Engineering (Aditi Shah) and CIO (Robert Lin) to validate fit before we proceed to procurement.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you hold a 30-40 minute demo geared at exec-level (high-level architecture, SLA/commitments, and a short Q&A)?
- We will need guidance on whether the session can be recorded for our internal stakeholders and whether that is acceptable to Redwood.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Jul 14, 10:00–10:40
- Wed Jul 15, 15:00–15:40
- Thu Jul 16, 09:00–09:40

Attaching the RFP excerpt that covers security / retention expectations (Helio_RFP.pdf). Please let us know which slot works and whether recording is permitted.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Senior Program Manager — Vendor Ops
HelioHealth

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@heliohealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + Exec demo: HelioHealth discovery and VP/CIO attendance

Hi Maya — great to connect, and thanks for sending the RFP snippet.

We can do an executive-oriented 35-minute session. Recording is fine from our side but we ask that Redwood be informed in advance and that internal distribution is limited to the procurement/leadership group listed in the RFP (we have a brief legal note we can share).

Two options that work for our execs here (PT):
- Tue Jul 14, 10:00–10:35 (preferred)
- Wed Jul 15, 15:00–15:35

I'll loop in Priyom (SE lead) who will run the demo and Vivek (sales lead) who will join for exec Q&A and commercial context. Priyom — can you prepare a 2-slide exec summary (3–4 bullets each) + a 10-minute demo top-line on cost/latency and a single-slide rollback/fallback plan? We should avoid heavy architecture deep-dive at execs, save that for a follow-up technical session.

Attaching a one-pager we typically share with CIOs (redwood-exec-onepager.pdf).

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@heliohealth.com>

Cc: Anirban Roy <anirban.roy@heliohealth.com>, sourcing@heliohealth.com
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + Exec demo: HelioHealth discovery and VP/CIO attendance

Priya — thanks, that sounds good.

We’ll take Tue Jul 14, 10:00–10:35 (Aditi & Robert confirmed). Recording is allowed for procurement review but needs the note from legal you mentioned; can you paste the short recording guidance we should include when we share the recording?

Also, would the demo content include a quick slide on expected token/unit cost ranges for a 3-month pilot? That’ll help our finance team decide on committed capacity. If you can add a single slide or quick table, that would be perfect.

Maya

Executive agenda (35 min):
1) 2-min intro & outcomes (Priya)
2) 6-min business impact + unit economics (Priyom)
3) 10-min live demo (Priyom)
4) 8-min commercial & pilot options (Vivek)
5) 9-min Q&A / next steps (all)

- If Redwood content that is sensitive is shown (e.g., kernel-level optimizations), we will request that portion be clipped out prior to distribution.
